items.source: Selects which implementation of AbstractCachingConfiguration should be used based on the value of EnableCaching.mode() on the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 根据导入的 `@Configuration` 类上EnableCaching.mode()的值，选择要使用的AbstractCachingConfiguration实现。

items.source: Uses of EnableCaching in org.springframework.cache.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.cache.annotation` 包中 `EnableCaching` 的用法

items.source: Annotations and supporting classes for declarative cache management.
items.translation: 用于声明式缓存管理的注解和辅助类。
